coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Limited partnership subscription agreement printed from a text filing: the investor completes sections 5-9, initials each representation (a joint owner initials beside), signs with an optional joint owner on page 6 and may direct distributions; the registered representative completes and signs the broker-dealer section; the partnership records payment and accepts on page 8.

sure_per_page.1: sure: no place; the letter-o bullets and the prospectus date are not places
sure_per_page.2: sure; the minimum shown in the additional investment caption is the issuer's, not a place
sure_per_page.3: sure of the places; digit-cell combs are one place per number on each line; lines and combs cut by the print's line wrap are recorded on both lines; the zip code row has no printed line
sure_per_page.4: sure; the section 9 occupation row has no printed line
sure_per_page.5: sure; state and plan representations are optional (must false)
sure_per_page.6: sure; the date line is the third column of the signature row, wrapped to the next line
sure_per_page.8: sure; the partnership use block is third-party (firm also accepted); the acceptance signature, name and title are the issuer's

1: the letter-o bullets before the investor notices
the prospectus date blank (the issuer completes it before sending)
2: the minimum amount blank inside the additional investment caption (issuer text)
3: the filing tags and the dashes and slashes between digit cells
11: the instruction bullets (small box glyphs used as bullets) on pages 11-14
